correctness.rationale: The graph matching contraction and classical Toeplitz criterion reduce extendibility to a strict gcd inequality. The exact formula enumerates all eligible a,x,y. A polytope volume gives N^3/12+O(N^2); the contribution of the gcd is a totient sum with coefficient 3/(2π²), and the boundary strip has O(N²) weighted mass. The standalone finite verifier independently checks the reduction and sums without claiming that finite checks prove the infinite theorem.
